Name: Abigail Centaur Horse Replacement
Author: zcsnightmare
Description:
[b]Abigail Centaur Horse Replacement[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/KBKLbv2.gif[/img]  [img]http://i.imgur.com/lUBoEnJ.gif[/img]

[b]  Install: [/b]
   - Go to your \Stardew Valley\Content\Animals folder
   - Always make sure to back up the files you're replacing, horse.xnb
   - Replace file with this horse.xnb
   - You're good to go!

  [b]Plans:
[/b]If it turns out people like my two centaur horse replacements (currently Abigail and Leah), I'll work on making all bachelor and bachelorettes as centaurs! Feel free to request a particular NPC, or I'll just randomly choose who to do next. ^.^ Any tips, suggestions, improvements? Please let me know! Still kind of new to this. 

  [b]Small Issue:
[/b]An FYI, a minor issue when traveling downward/south, due to the vanilla horse's head not having a large enough space, sides of the centaurs' hair will be overlapped by your character's shoes. Unfortunately, there is no way for me to bypass this (probably could go into farmer's files, crop the shoes for when riding, but that's quite a few steps for a simple re-skin.) But, I did my best to make it look as good as I could. It's up to your discretion if it's acceptable or not. (example included below)
